0022600100.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-1) are the away side in their second game of the season, sitting 9th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, one game back. The Utah Jazz (0-1) are also 0-1 after one game, 12th in the West, and are without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot), while Tony Bradley (quadriceps) and Trey Alexander (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The Pelicans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 156-137 win in New Orleans on April 7, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season between the two teams.
